question: Under this policy, will I pay a withdrawal charge?

calls.content:
Yes, you will generally pay a withdrawal charge for most cash withdrawals from this policy.
Currently, each cash withdrawal is subject to a fee of US$25, HK$200, or MOP$200 [S2].
This per-withdrawal fee is also confirmed in the product notes as the current charge for each withdrawal [S4].
However, the withdrawal charge is waived if you use the automatic periodic withdrawal option [S2].
This waiver applies specifically when you exercise the automatic periodic withdrawal option, which has its own eligibility requirements [S4].
Separately, if you surrender the policy or decrease the Basic Sum Insured within the first 14 years, a different surrender charge applies based on factors like age and smoking status [S2].
This surrender charge is distinct from the per-withdrawal fee and is calculated based on the Surrender Charge Rate [S2].
